Software Requirement Speciﬁcation 
Banking Login Module 
 
Module 
Authentication 
 
Business Priority 
High 
 
Functional Requirements 
 
REQ-001 
The application shall allow a registered customer to log in using a valid username and 
password. 
 
REQ-002 
If invalid credentials are entered, an appropriate error message shall be displayed. 
 
REQ-003 
The application shall lock the account after ﬁve consecutive failed login attempts. 
 
REQ-004 
Users shall be able to reset forgotten passwords using registered email. 
 
REQ-005 
The Remember Me option shall preserve login for 30 days. 
 
REQ-006 
Session shall expire after 15 minutes of inactivity. 
 
REQ-007 
Passwords shall be masked. 
 
REQ-008 
Username is mandatory. 
 
REQ-009 
Password is mandatory. 
 
REQ-010 
Successful login redirects user to Dashboard.

232bfcfb-44a3-40a0-a0d8-baf916d1a315.description:
Banking Login Module Requirements 
Project: Banking Portal QA Automation 
Module: Authentication 
Target Application: https://sampleapp.tricentis.com/101/app.php 
 
Requirement REQ-001 
Title 
User Login 
Priority 
High 
Description 
The system shall allow registered users to log into the banking portal using a valid username 
and password. 
Acceptance Criteria: 
 
Username is mandatory.  
 
Password is mandatory.  
 
Valid credentials navigate to Dashboard.  
 
Invalid credentials display an error.  
 
Password is masked.  
 
Login activity is recorded.  
 
Requirement REQ-002 
Title 
Account Lockout 
Priority 
High 
Description 
The application shall lock a user account after ﬁve consecutive failed login attempts. 
Acceptance Criteria 
 
Counter resets after successful login.  
 
Lockout message displayed.  
 
Locked users cannot authenticate.  
 
Administrator can unlock account.  
 
Requirement REQ-003 
Title 
Forgot Password 
Priority 
Medium 
Description 
Users shall reset passwords through registered email veriﬁcation. 
Acceptance Criteria 
 
Registered email required.  
 
OTP expires after 5 minutes.  
 
Password policy enforced.  
 
Success conﬁrmation displayed.  
 
Requirement REQ-004 
Title 
Remember Me 
Priority 
Low 
Description 
Users may remain logged in using Remember Me. 
Acceptance Criteria 
 
Session persists for 30 days.  
 
User may logout anytime.  
 
Cookies are encrypted.  
 
Remember Me can be disabled.  
 
Requirement REQ-005 
Title 
Session Timeout 
Priority 
Medium 
Description 
Inactive sessions shall automatically expire after 15 minutes. 
Acceptance Criteria 
 
Warning appears 60 seconds before timeout.  
 
Session expires automatically.  
 
Redirect to Login page.  
 
Unsaved work warning displayed.

steps: Navigate to the login page of the Banking Login Module
2595ad5a-8b02-41fd-846f-5ee7376b1513.expected_result: The application successfully redirects the user to the Dashboard with no errors displayed.
2595ad5a-8b02-41fd-846f-5ee7376b1513.evaluation_reason: clear steps but doesn't test password masking or account locking

6bfbb573-7251-49dc-b7c7-a14a92c6f1b5.title: Invalid Username and Password
preconditions: Login to the Banking Portal using a guest account
steps: Enter an invalid username in the login form
Enter an invalid password in the password field
6bfbb573-7251-49dc-b7c7-a14a92c6f1b5.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating invalid credentials.
6bfbb573-7251-49dc-b7c7-a14a92c6f1b5.evaluation_reason: tests invalid credentials but doesn't check for error message specifics or account lockout behavior

29431664-76ea-4652-a5c2-c7dffae371d2.title: Forgot Password - Registered Email Required
preconditions: User has a registered email address associated with their account
steps: Click on the Forgot Password link in the login form
Enter a valid registered email address in the email field
29431664-76ea-4652-a5c2-c7dffae371d2.expected_result: The system sends an OTP to the registered email address and displays a success message.
29431664-76ea-4652-a5c2-c7dffae371d2.evaluation_reason: clear steps but expected result is too vague regarding password reset process
